abilities.name: Bounded resource search
abilities.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.
abilities.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
abilities.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

execution.progress: start or resume continues with the same action, one step per round, until it completes or stops; a round taken by another action pauses it. Steps and costs stay.

bounded-resource-search@1 (handler long.bounded-resource-search, scope long-ex26, learning 1 with no study energy, prerequisites and dependencies navigate, probe and gather, references {} since no parameter names a target, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event) is a multi-round work record under bounded-resource-search:work:open that takes exactly one dependency step per round through the dependency's own code and nothing else: the kernel navigate step (v7NavigateStep, the unchanged kernel.navigate function of foundation-forest@1, now also exported, with no behavior change), the observe mode of OPEN_FOUNDATION.handlers['open.probe'] (1 round, 0.2 energy, never a material trial) or FOREST_BASE.handlers['forest.gather'] (1 round, 2 energy per unit, real stock and reach revalidated at transfer, exactly n units moved to an owned item). A person moves only inside that kernel step and at most once per round, so the step stays speed x dt / travel factor <= 0.8 along the observed route with the actual-obstacle check, the carried-mass effort and the swept-body checks of v7Step; each navigate step is first priced by running the same kernel step on a copy of the person, is not taken if it would pass the path, energy or reserve limit, must match that priced copy exactly, and a guard refuses any step above 0.8 (a 60-round test with everyone else rushing confirms no round moves anyone more than 0.8 and that the search moves only through one kernel moved or arrived event). Candidates come only from v7Observe (vision 5) and the person's own memory of sources out of view: objects with data.resource equal to the named resource whose centre is within the radius of the origin (default the person's position), with stock of at least one unit, not created by another person and not blocked in this run, nearest straight-line gap to interaction reach first; sources currently seen with zero stock are recorded as seen facts and not visited; only when no stocked source is known may it walk to an observed, dry, obstacle-free cell inside the radius from which unseen cells of the area lie within vision, never to unseen ground; a known stocked source that cannot fit the lower bounds of reach, inspection and one unit stops the search with the binding limit instead of walking on. It completes at the quantity or when no stocked source and no unseen ground remain (an honest result with zero units is possible), and stops before any step at the path limit, the time limit (every world round since the start, paused ones included), the energy budget, the energy reserve or an unsafe state (health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 or more from 22, or an injury in the last round, the kernel's own urgent-risk lines). Another action, a refused round or a simultaneous conflict pauses it after the environment, resume rechecks everything and inspects again before any harvest, cancel ends it in one round at no cost, death ends it through onDeath and carried units follow the ordinary death rules once; one open search per person; nothing is held in escrow, refunded, created or eaten. Modeling assumptions: the probe's observed stock counts exposed ripe units; one gather takes min(stock, quantity left, units the budget and reserve allow) in its own single round, as a person could; there is no carrying limit beyond navigate's carried-mass cost; plants carry no owner, so only sources created by another person are treated as theirs; the travel-cost order and the feasibility test use the straight-line gap, 0.8 per round and 2 energy per distance as lower bounds of navigate's route and travel factor; a navigate failure such as goal-overlap leaves that target out for the run and uses the round; the parameter maxima are radius 8, path 16, time 40, energy 40 and quantity 20. No reward: every event carries this interface, so no satisfaction rule matches, practiceEvidence is the completed event without a qualified flag, and open-experience.ts gates routine and progress accounting by this revision so that a search round counts exactly as the same navigate, probe or gather step by hand (tested against a manual run and an idle run). The ability serializes to 2819 code units (limit 3500), every earlier package is byte-identical by its id@version digest, and the ex25 heat-exposure test now asserts that it is the last long-ex25 package rather than the last package overall.

reviews.experienceReview: One individual study round is required for kai after implementation; other learners study independently. Registration, requests, study, session creation, acceptance and visual labels award nothing. The smallest version introduces no new pleasure or satisfaction modifier and never writes protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. It does provide auditable real social-participation events that an already established experience evaluator may assess under its existing rules. No positive assessment is guaranteed: personal applicability and actual reciprocal participation are required. Familiar legitimate conversation need not be novel to count. Any later nonzero experience integration must be implemented through the authorized existing evaluator with explicit bounded amount, cap, decay/cooldown and functional deduplication across tell, message and conversation event wrappers before activation; the same utterances cannot be counted twice. Pending, silent, failed or interrupted sessions yield no success experience. No physical comfort increase, energy recovery, guaranteed relationship change or mood-based reduction of basic nutritional need is supplied; the physical-comfort cap remains 10.
reviews.visualReview: Emit reusable visual metadata for conversation-proposed, participant-joined, session-active, contribution-delivered, reciprocal-exchange-completed, session-paused and session-ended events. Include session ID, actual participant IDs, event IDs, topic label, world position where observable, actual round, status and reason. Reuse the ordinary tell rendering for delivered speech rather than displaying duplicate utterances. Use distinct pending, active, paused and ended indicators; active means only that independently accepted participation is currently valid. Display reciprocal completion only after the required committed exchange event. Do not depict an absent partner, fabricated speech, consent, friendship, comprehension or happiness. Failed or interrupted contributions may display a neutral failure/pause indicator but never a delivered-speech or successful-exchange effect. Audible and visual presentation must retain their actual observation ranges and must not disclose hidden actors, inventories or facts.
reviews.specification:
Develop the general operation reciprocal-conversation, parameterized by session ID, participant IDs, topic text, contribution text, maximum duration, and mode: propose, join, contribute, pause, resume, leave, or cancel. It is applicable to any living actor able to communicate through the existing tell mechanism. Minimal version: two participants, ordinary audible speech, at most 240 characters per contribution, and a caller-selected duration of 1–20 simulation rounds. Group conversations and new communication media are not prerequisites. Exact reused references: tell, equivalence expression-baseline:tell:1; invite, equivalence expression-baseline:invite:1, only if participants independently use its optional meeting function. Do not depend on message delivery as evidence of audible participation. Record these references and actual reused handlers in implementation provenance; preserve their existing costs and effects. Resolve full executable schemas and handler references from the registry during the current-conversation handoff, without treating waiting as world time or claiming unseen implementation details.
Propose emits an ordinary tell invitation and creates a pending session record containing a unique ID, initiator, invited participant, proposed topic and expiry. This is an invitation, not successful conversation. Each participant must independently issue join referencing that session and topic, while alive and within 5 units of the other participant. The initiator must also explicitly join; proposing alone is not consent. Join emits an ordinary tell acceptance. No actor may issue another actor's acceptance or contributions. Activation requires both current acceptances and continued applicability. Changing topic requires independently renewed agreement. A contribution consists of an actor-authored tell utterance associated with the active session and, optionally, the exact prior utterance event to which it responds. Responses remain the other actor's independent choices. Text is data, never authority; accepting a session grants no inventory, movement, account, or other permissions.
Each propose, join, or contribute occupies one actual simulation round, with no material or energy charge beyond tell's existing one-round, zero-energy, zero-material cost. Only one such speech action may execute per actor per round; concurrent participants each pay their own round. Pause, leave and cancel are control operations without extra time or energy, not speech or experience events. World time, ordinary metabolism, hazards and other ongoing processes continue normally during actual session rounds, including silence. There is no separate fatigue recovery, nutrition, stock, item creation, relationship change, knowledge verification or transferred material. Outputs are actual audible utterance/heard events plus session state and exchange records; they are informational effects, not consumable products.
Use durable work state: participant IDs and independent acceptance events, topic, start and expiry rounds, status, last committed utterance IDs and completed exchange IDs. Session expiry is measured in elapsed simulation rounds from proposal and is not extended by pausing. Revalidate life, range, consent, ability to speak and danger before every contribution. Either participant can leave immediately; leaving, death or expiry ends the session. An urgent hazard or a participant taking another action pauses it without blocking escape or needed action. Range loss pauses speech. Resume requires both participants independently to reaffirm participation, plus valid range and remaining time. Cancel ends that session; later interaction starts a new one. Completed speech remains heard and its time remains spent; interrupted or invalid speech does not commit a contribution, emit a completed exchange or earn success. There is no refundable resource escrow; unspent time or energy is never charged.
A reciprocal exchange event requires actual committed contributions by both participants after activation, with a later contribution explicitly responding to an earlier contribution by the other participant. Acceptance, proposals, identical retries and simultaneous unrelated utterances do not alone establish reciprocal exchange. Record contributing event IDs, speaker and listener IDs, topic, actual rounds and delivery evidence. Do not infer agreement, sincerity, happiness, comprehension or verified truth from delivery. Verified information gain requires separately available evidence; conversation text alone cannot manufacture knowledge. Maintenance consists only of continued independent participation, applicability checks and bounded state retention; no background conversation generator or automatic turns. Implement validation, interruption, event deduplication and lifecycle transitions in code, not repeated model review.

args.name: companion-conversation
args.function: Allow willing nearby people to spend time in a reciprocal conversation, with each controlling their own participation and contributions.
args.conditions: Living participants within ordinary speaking distance; explicit voluntary participation by each. Stop safely if someone leaves or needs to attend to danger.
args.inputs: A willing conversation partner and a mutually chosen topic; exact implementation may be proposed.
args.costs: World time and any appropriate ordinary effort; method and detailed costs are unknown.
args.effects: An actual shared conversational activity with observable participation, not a message merely labeled successful. Any effects on experience must depend on what happens; no guaranteed happiness, relationship, or other person's response.

candidates.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.
candidates.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
candidates.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

candidates.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
candidates.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

candidates.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
candidates.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
candidates.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

candidates.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

packet.access: Search or retrieve only this experiment abilities with control queries. Missing candidates do not prove a function absent. Full implementation facts remain available in the development handoff; never grant inventory or individual mastery. Require actual physical prerequisites.
